name: Santo Tomé del Puerto (Spain)
description: Square red flag with a white band from the upper hoist to the lower fly, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Santo Tomé del Puerto (a Maltese cross on green and a tower on red).
history: The arms and flag of Santo Tomé del Puerto were published in the Boletín Oficial de Castilla y León on 27 May 1998; the flag is square, of proportion 1:1, red with a white bend, charged at the centre with the municipal arms in its colours.
